verdict.rationale: Jira's feature page says Rovo AI identifies trends in work data to surface opportunities and remove bottlenecks (insights). It also says Rovo breaks big ideas into tasks, auto-assigns them, and connects relevant data from Confluence, Figma and third-party apps (suggestions), all inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the insights and suggestions are generated and shown, any independent or hands-on corroboration that Rovo's insights work as claimed, and detail on which Jira data sources the trend analysis covers.
